scope_rule: This policy grants delivery lifecycle actions only. Program objectives, Work Order scope, files, systems, risk, and protected-resource access must come from separate active ratified authority.
routine_operator_actions: select the next dependency-cleared Work Order
create and repair dedicated worktrees and branches
run validation and remediate in-scope failures
open or update the pull request
resolve in-scope review comments and ordinary conflicts
revalidate the exact pull request head
close the Work Order and update evidence and routing
continue to the next dependency-cleared Work Order
true_authority_walls: new program, objective, or material scope not already ratified
constitutional or sovereign-canon decision with multiple valid policy outcomes
production activation, release, cutover, or irreversible production mutation not already authorized
credentials, secrets, signing ceremonies, private keys, or owner-controlled trust material
destructive or materially irreversible action outside an approved rollback envelope
legal, contractual, financial, procurement, licensing, employment, or political decision
protected county data or system access beyond existing authorization
material security exception or acceptance of known high-severity risk
controlling-authority conflict unresolved by documented precedence
external spending or resource commitment not already approved
invalid_stop_classifications: MERGE_AUTH_REQUIRED for an eligible pull request covered by this standing authority
OWNER_DECISION_NEEDED for routine implementation or validation choices inside authorized scope
OWNER_DECISION_NEEDED for selecting the next dependency-cleared Work Order
OWNER_DECISION_NEEDED because an operator has ordinary technical uncertainty
merge_auth_required_only_when: no applicable standing or bounded merge authority exists
suspension_triggers: scope expansion outside active ratified authority
unresolved review thread at merge time
explicitly_denied: creation of a new program, objective, or material scope
production, deployment, county, PACS, SQL, credential, secret, or protected-data authority
destructive action outside an approved rollback envelope
required-check, branch-protection, review, exact-head, or reservation bypass
force push or direct push to main
legal, financial, procurement, licensing, employment, or political authority
terminal_condition: Remains active until William explicitly revokes or narrows it; affected actions suspend automatically on any suspension trigger.
